en: A monochrome postcard view of a large suspension bridge crossing a calm river, with two massive stone towers at each end. Small boats are moored along the riverbank, and a town with multi‑storey buildings lies behind the bridge, backed by wooded hills. At the top in red German text it identifies the scene as the Empress Elisabeth chain bridge and the view toward Obergrund in Jetschen‑Bodenbach.
